title: Do Stack Overflow Answer Edits Occur Beyond Java? A Replication on Python and JavaScript
abstract: arXiv:2608.08361v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Stack Overflow answers are continually revised by the community, and the edits made to their code snippets are a potential source of improvements for code that has been reused in open-source projects. A recent empirical study established this for Java, reporting that 16.11% of accepted Java answers are edited and that the resulting recommendations concentrate in highly popular GitHub projects. translated_title: Stack Overflow答案编辑是否超越了Java？对Python和JavaScript的重复研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.08361v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：Stack Overflow的答案由社区持续修订，对其代码片段的编辑可能为开源项目中复用的代码提供改进来源。最近一项实证研究针对Java建立了这一现象，报告称16.11%的被接受Java答案被编辑，且由此产生的建议集中在高人气GitHub项目中。这种行为是Stack Overflow的特性还是Java社区的特性，仍然是一个未解问题。我们在Python和JavaScript（与Java并列最广泛使用的两种语言）上重复了该研究，应用相同的基于SOTorrent的提取流程、相同的克隆搜索工具Siamese+以及相同的项目人气标准。通过分析840,132个被接受的Python答案和1,144,185个被接受的JavaScript答案，我们发现分别有41.25%和39.10%的答案至少被编辑过一次，约为Java案例的两倍半。
tldr: 该研究在Python和JavaScript上重复了Java的实证分析，发现编辑比例显著更高（约40% vs 16%），表明答案编辑行为是Stack Overflow的普遍特性而非Java社区特有。
en_tdlr: This replication study on Python and JavaScript finds significantly higher answer edit rates (~40% vs 16% in Java), indicating that answer editing is a general Stack Overflow phenomenon rather than Java-specific.
